issue_context.title: Not embedded font subset can't be substitute
issue_context.body:
Attach (recommended) or Link to PDF file here:
[a.html.pdf](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/files/14948183/a.html.pdf)

Configuration:
- Web browser and its version: Firefox nightly
- Operating system and its version: Windows 11

Steps to reproduce the problem:
1. Install the GoNotoCurrent-Regular font
2. Open the pdf with `pdfBug=all`
3. In looking the Font Inspector, we can infer that no substitution occurred.

Since the font is a subset, its name is prefixed with a tag which should be stripped out before trying to guess a substitution.

review_comments: Could you add the PDF file from the issue as a reference test so we exercise this new logic to avoid regressions?

I just noticed that we fortunately have unit tests for this function at https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/master/test/unit/font_substitutions_spec.js so aside from the reference test it might be good to, if possible of course, add a unit test for this too since that could surface any regressions sooner in the development process as they are much faster to run than the reference tests.
